units.source_text: 今早，我甚至想，一切都撒手不管了。

en.t: This morning, I even thought of simply dropping everything and leaving it all behind.

units.source_text: 每天上学之前，我总要去问问有什么事情，今天却一声不响就走出家门了。

en.t: Every day before going to school, I would always go and ask whether there was anything to be done, but today I left the house without saying a word.

units.source_text: 然而，从学校一回到家里，心头就涌起一股思绪，还是觉得他挺可怜的。

en.t: Yet as soon as I came home from school, a thought welled up in my heart, and I still felt that he was rather pitiful.
